_comment: Hornero plugin hooks. Session lifecycle only — guardrail hooks (validate-skill, catalog-regen, smoke-check) live in templates/settings.json because they reference Hornero scripts that require a path your installation knows about. Add those to your own .claude/settings.json if you want them; this file stays self-contained so the plugin loads cleanly from any host.

hooks.command: echo '↪ Hornero loaded. Just describe what you'\''re working on — I'\''ll route to the right lens. Or: /hornero:kickoff (guided start), /hornero:catalog (see what'\''s available).'
echo 'Session ending. Consider /hornero:extract-lesson if anything was surprising or worth capturing.'
